meta.name: biopython
meta.description: Comprehensive molecular biology toolkit. Use for sequence manipulation, file parsing (FASTA/GenBank/PDB), phylogenetics, and programmatic NCBI/PubMed access (Bio.Entrez). Best for batch processing, custom bioinformatics pipelines, BLAST automation. For quick lookups use gget; for multi-service integration use bioservices.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会用 Python 的 Biopython 库处理生物数据：读写与转换 FASTA、GenBank、PDB 等序列文件，做序列比对、BLAST 检索和系统发育树分析，并通过 Bio.Entrez 访问 NCBI 数据库。
howto.when: 当你要求处理 DNA、RNA 或蛋白序列、解析生物文件格式，或批量跑 BLAST、经 Entrez 访问 NCBI 数据库时接管。

howto.what_en: With it installed, Claude uses Python's Biopython to work with biological data: reading, writing and converting FASTA/GenBank/PDB files, running alignments, BLAST searches and phylogenetic tree analysis, and querying NCBI databases through Bio.Entrez.
howto.when_en: Use it when you ask to handle DNA, RNA or protein sequences, parse biological file formats, or run batch BLAST and Entrez queries against NCBI databases.
